rules: Every price lookup must resolve using (strategy_id, asset, execution_object, leg_id, venue/source, timestamp)
A BTC leg may NEVER read ETH data
An ETH leg may NEVER read BTC data
A spot leg may NEVER silently use perp price
A perp leg may NEVER silently use spot price
A relative-value strategy must explicitly map each leg
No fallback to first-available-dataframe or shared mutable state
data_unavailability_rule: BLOCK_DATA_REQUIREMENT — do not substitute another series silently
implementation: PriceStore class with typed key access (asset, market_type, source)
